title: BACKND Base country code
summary: CountryCode enum (under BackEnd.GlobalSupport) covering 196 countries, used to tag users and guilds so the console can filter/search by country. Includes the full code list and how to apply a country code.
capabilities: route country-code questions to the enum list and apply flow
explain how country codes enable console-side country filtering
map CountryCode enum to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2
prerequisites: SDK is initialized and the user is logged in for apply flows
common_pitfalls: Hardcoding a country string instead of the CountryCode enum
Assuming a code without checking the official 196-country list
verification_required_for: exact enum values for a specific country
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route to confirm a specific CountryCode value before use.
Verify the apply flow and where the code is stored upstream.
public_notes: CountryCode is an enum under BackEnd.GlobalSupport covering 196 countries.
Used for console-side country filtering of users and guilds.
